source_ref.text: Charmed: cannot attack charmer. Existing canonical charmed_by identity only. Harmful spells/abilities, social checks and unknown-source provenance remain OPEN.

Invisible attack benefits do not apply against creature that can see it. Explicit trusted directional sight premises, not ordinary line of sight or detected/located. Special-sense production remains OPEN.
Playing the Game: same-kind sources never stack; opposing kinds cancel regardless of count. Eligible-source fixture premises, not class/feature eligibility acceptance.
Exhaustion D20 penalty; Initiative is Dexterity check in Playing the Game. K07 release_v2. Death at6/removal are not covered by this leaf.
Long Rest: wait at least16 hours after finishing before starting another. K07 release_v2. Legacy absent completion history stays unknown, first recorded rest permitted.
Invisible Initiative advantage; Incapacitated PDF368; surprise Chapter1. K07 release_v2, no attack-visibility exception applied to Initiative.
Dodge benefits and loss; K07 release_v2 glossary. Incapacitated PDF368, Restrained PDF372, Speed PDF373. Bounded observation, not all Dodge implementation.
Ability Scores and Modifiers table
both Advantage and Disadvantage: neither, roll one d20 (the boolean engine API cannot express several sources of one kind; that aggregation is a separate OPEN rule)
Expertise doubles the Proficiency Bonus for the check; p.12: the bonus can be multiplied only once, never stacked
Temporary Hit Points are lost first; leftover damage carries to Hit Points (5 temp + 7 damage = 2 HP lost)
Temporary Hit Points never wake a creature at 0 Hit Points; only real healing does (Damage and Healing).

Death Saving Throws and Stabilizing a Character: 10+ succeeds; 1 causes two failures; 20 regains 1 HP; third success stabilizes; third failure kills; damage at 0 HP causes failure (two on a Critical Hit, death at HP maximum); successful DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) stabilizes; Stable creatures remain unconscious, resume saves if damaged, and regain 1 HP after 1d4 hours.
Dropping to 0 Hit Points: Massive Damage (leftover damage equal to the Hit Point maximum kills outright)
Dropping to 0 Hit Points: Massive Damage (leftover damage equal to the Hit Point maximum kills outright)
Dropping to 0 Hit Points: Massive Damage (leftover damage equal to the Hit Point maximum kills outright)

Unconscious condition: a creature knocked out at 0 Hit Points is Prone; an attack that hits an Unconscious creature is a Critical Hit only when the attacker is within 5 feet of it (a farther ranged hit is an ordinary hit); regaining Hit Points does not stand a Prone creature up. Page is the Unconscious entry of the K07 release_v2 glossary (PDF ordinal 376); not re-opened against the PDF in this slice.
Proficiency Bonus table: Up to 4 +2, 5-8 +3, 9-12 +4, 13-16 +5, 17-20 +6 (character levels; the table also lists CR 21-30 for monsters, not a character level)

Long Rest (Rules Glossary): at least 8 hours; needs at least 1 Hit Point to start; regain all lost HP; Exhaustion level decreases by 1; not possible during combat (rolling Initiative interrupts). Engine note: the 0 HP refusal comes from the generic require_player_can_act guard (not a Long Rest rule); the combat refusal is an interpretation of rolling Initiative interrupting a rest

Actions list (12 actions); Dash gives extra movement equal to Speed; a Bonus Action only when a feature grants one and only one per turn, anything that deprives you of taking actions also prevents a Bonus Action; a Reaction cannot be taken again until the start of your next turn; movement can be split around actions

open_leaves.reason: class skill-choice counts/options, background skills, and the saving-throw total applied during play (saving_bonus, feat/species adders, exhaustion) are not oracle-covered; the creation save modifiers cover only the level-1 Proficiency Bonus of 2 (higher levels belong to C06); Sorcerer saves were read in C06 and are also run here
eligible weapon/Initiative source aggregation covered by K07.advantage_disadvantage_source_aggregation.weapon_and_initiative; skill/save/spell source routing and source eligibility remain OPEN
PHB lets the player choose between two Temporary Hit Point amounts; the engine keeps the higher automatically

NO_ENGINE_RESOLVER: no ability-score restoration; 16-hour start spacing covered by K07.long_rest_start_spacing (PDF369), legacy absent completion history is unknown; Hit Point Dice are covered by K07.hit_dice_short_and_long_rest

not covered: features that recharge on a Short Rest (species Short Rest features are not given after an interrupted Long Rest), damage after the rest other than via the HP guard, a level applied between the rest and the spend, Hit Dice display in the UI, interruptions by walking/exertion (PDF 370); Hit Point Dice spending is covered by K07.hit_dice_short_and_long_rest

species uses and spell slots are restored by Long Rest in the engine; per-feature recharge rules are not oracle-covered. ENGINE DIVERGENCE (untested): with supplies tracking on and a missing food/water record the engine skips the Exhaustion reduction, the glossary always reduces it by 1; rest interrupted by a time event and the interruptions in the glossary (rolling Initiative, casting a non-cantrip spell) are only partly covered

not oracle-covered: Charmed effects beyond attacks against known canonical charmer (K07.charmed_attack_charmer), Deafened, Frightened (movement and line of sight), Invisible effects beyond Initiative advantage and explicit directed sight attack exception (covered by K07.initiative_invisible and K07.invisible_attack_explicit_sight_exception); special-sense sight production remains OPEN, Blinded auto-fail on sight checks, Prone crawling and standing cost, Unconscious dropping items, Exhaustion D20 penalties beyond Initiative (covered by K07.initiative_exhaustion_penalty) and death at level 6, Dehydration/Malnutrition exhaustion removal, outside-combat movement still blocked for Incapacitated/Stunned by exploration._busy (Speed is correct there, journeys are not), a Grapple ending when the grappler is Incapacitated (not modelled); sources: K07 release_v2 (scope_and_exceptions.json unsupported list applies)

which features grant Bonus Actions/Reactions (Cunning Action, Opportunity Attack triggers, Shield and other reaction spells, Action Surge) belong to the class/spell tasks (C05, C10-C21) and K05; free object interaction and the 'one thing at a time' rule are not oracle-covered; the dispatcher sets reaction_spent directly because the only engine reaction path needs a Ready opportunity, so 'a spent Reaction refuses a second one' and 'Incapacitated prevents a Reaction' are UNVERIFIED; Dodge benefits/loss are covered by K07.dodge_benefits_loss; its activation/expiry and the effects of Disengage, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, Study are not oracle-covered (the leaf checks only the 12 names); not covered: Action Surge/extra actions, bonus grants of quantity > 1, out_of_turn refusals, double Dash, speed 0, prone/difficult-terrain movement cost, exhaustion/grapple speed reduction; the former Incapacitated Speed 0 divergence is fixed (K07.conditions_speed_actions_attacks_saves)
